text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month treasury bills rose, nine-month and 18-month yields slipped, and 12-month yields were unchanged from the last sales,a central bank statement said on Thursday.

Six-month bills edged up to 20.20 percent from 19.64 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 27.75 percent from 27.81 percent, 12-month bills were unchanged at 30.34 percent and 18-month bills eased to 32.54 percent from 32.54 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 45.00 million UAH 44.50 million UAH
Amount sold 33.03 million UAH 18.19 million UAH
Actual amount raised 30.01 million UAH 16.57 million UAH
The central bank sold 330,298 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 15.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 40.00 million UAH 44.00 million UAH
Amount sold 25.04 million UAH 44.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 20.74 million UAH 36.42 million UAH
The central bank sold 250,414 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 15.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 105.69 million UAH 98.93 million UAH
Actual amount raised 81.13 million UAH 75.95 million UAH
The central bank sold 1,056,870 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 15.
The results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 31.51 million UAH 24.34 million UAH
Actual amount raised 21.19 million UAH 16.37 million UAH
The central bank sold 315,090 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 15.
